limitations: No runnable live asset bundle provided; inspection restricted to static captured PNGs and standalone source markup.
Automated axe checks report zero violations, but this provides no evidence regarding assistive technology screen reader speech rendering or actual human ergonomic usability.
Session state is contained entirely in client-side runtime variables without URL parameter or local storage persistence across browser reload.
Bound to static natural-viewport frame captures at 1440px and 320px widths.

firstActionSalience.evidence: proofdesk/A/1440-initial.png (stock sidebar visible alongside queue list) vs proofdesk/B/1440-initial.png (queue toolbar and countbox prominent without stock sidebar)
firstActionSalience.tradeoff: Variant A surfaces paper availability upfront but introduces competing visual weight alongside the job list; Variant B keeps the initial queue unencumbered but withholds paper inventory context until opening a job.

decisionContextRetention.evidence: proofdesk/B/source.html#L44 (back preserves queueScroll and restores scroll position) and proofdesk/B/1440-review.png (review list explicitly renders remaining sheets as '95 of 120') vs proofdesk/A/source.html#L41 (showQueue resets scroll to top) and proofdesk/A/1440-review.png (displays raw '95' without baseline denominator)
decisionContextRetention.tradeoff: Variant B requires entering a job to view total paper availability, whereas Variant A shows global inventory immediately on the queue screen.

errorAndRecoveryClarity.evidence: proofdesk/B/1440-failure.png, proofdesk/B/source.html#L48,L55, and proofdesk/B/checks.json#L739-L743 (alert sits above job details and focus automatically advances to 'Retry approval' button) vs proofdesk/A/1440-failure.png and proofdesk/A/source.html#L48 (failure notice injected below list and shifts focus to static #failure div)
errorAndRecoveryClarity.tradeoff: Directing keyboard focus to the Retry button in Variant B relies on aria-live/role='alert' announcement rather than placing the browsing cursor inside the explanatory copy.

responsiveAccess.evidence: proofdesk/B/320-initial.png and proofdesk/B/source.html#L10,L13 (object-fit: contain keeps vector artwork and 'P-104' label fully visible, with full-width button wrapping) vs proofdesk/A/320-initial.png and proofdesk/A/source.html#L13 (fixed 78px width with object-fit: cover visibly clips artwork text into '-104')
responsiveAccess.tradeoff: Variant B's stacked full-width button and unclipped thumbnail aspect ratio increase the vertical height of each job card on narrow viewports.

semanticControlAndFocus.evidence: proofdesk/B/source.html#L43-L44,L55 and proofdesk/B/checks.json#L765-L769 (restores focus to data-open button on queue return, advances focus to retry button upon failure, and manages live region announcements) vs proofdesk/A/source.html#L48 (focuses non-interactive div#failure with tabindex='-1' upon failure)
semanticControlAndFocus.tradeoff: Variant B focuses the action button on error rather than the descriptive alert container.

contentToThesis.evidence: proofdesk/A/source.html#L11, proofdesk/A/1440-review.png (prepress registration corner crosses and paper on hand sidebar) vs proofdesk/B/source.html#L10, proofdesk/B/1440-review.png (cutting mat grid background and sheet ledger)
contentToThesis.tradeoff: Variant A emphasizes prepress sheet inventory and registration framing; Variant B emphasizes cutting mat workbench inspection.

suppliedArtifactsShapeComposition.evidence: proofdesk/B/320-initial.png and proofdesk/B/1440-review.png (preserves complete SVG aspect ratio and vector artwork bounds across breakpoints) vs proofdesk/A/320-initial.png (clips left margin of vector proof, truncating P-104 identifier to -104)
suppliedArtifactsShapeComposition.tradeoff: The cutting mat grid pattern in Variant B introduces visual texture directly behind proof margins.

coherentMediaTypeDirection.evidence: proofdesk/B/source.html#L10 and proofdesk/B/320-initial.png (object-fit: contain maintains vector graphic integrity and proportions without edge clipping at narrow widths)
coherentMediaTypeDirection.tradeoff: Letterboxing occurs inside the thumbnail frame when artwork aspect ratios deviate from 5:3.

honestEvidenceLimits.evidence: proofdesk/A/source.html#L20,L22,L47 ('Local demonstration', 'No printing, charging or sending', 'Paper stock is not deducted') vs proofdesk/B/source.html#L25,L30,L48 ('Local demonstration', 'One copy. One sheet', 'Shared paper stock stays unchanged')
honestEvidenceLimits.tradeoff: Both variants rely strictly on ephemeral in-memory state that clears upon session reload.

firstActionSalience.evidence: cabinet/A/1440-initial.png and cabinet/A/source.html#L53-L54 (comparison shelf is hidden until a panel is pinned; clear card actions with explicit 'Open SC-01' pills) vs cabinet/B/1440-initial.png and cabinet/B/source.html#L34 (comparison shelf permanently fixed at bottom even when empty, occluding bottom-row card text)
firstActionSalience.tradeoff: In Variant A, the visitor does not see the physical shelf UI until their first pin interaction, relying on the header hint 'Pin any two to compare'.

decisionContextRetention.evidence: cabinet/A/source.html#L57,L59 (stores returnScroll and returnFocus; restores scroll and focuses origin card button) vs cabinet/B/source.html#L77,L82 (stores state.scroll and state.returnId; restores scroll and focuses origin button)
decisionContextRetention.tradeoff: Neither variant serializes filter queries or pinned panel IDs into the URL search or hash parameters.

errorAndRecoveryClarity.evidence: cabinet/A/1440-failure.png and cabinet/A/source.html#L58 (unoccluded standalone failure card with explicit 'Retry detail' action and retained pin context) vs cabinet/B/1440-failure.png and cabinet/B/source.html#L10,L80 (floating feedback banner at bottom: 125px overlaps the comparison shelf and content area)

responsiveAccess.evidence: cabinet/A/320-initial.png and cabinet/A/source.html#L13 (single-column cards stack cleanly without bottom occlusion while shelf is inactive) vs cabinet/B/320-initial.png and cabinet/B/source.html#L13 (fixed shelf occupies ~85px of vertical screen height even with 0 panels pinned)

semanticControlAndFocus.evidence: cabinet/A/source.html#L50,L55,L59 (aria-pressed on pin buttons, aria-label with dynamic Pin/Unpin text, and focus returned to opened trigger) vs cabinet/B/source.html#L49,L62,L82 (equivalent aria-pressed, aria-label, and focus restoration to data-open button)

contentToThesis.evidence: cabinet/A/1440-initial.png and cabinet/A/source.html#L10 (signboard stages include corner mounting holes via CSS pseudo-elements, evoking architectural wayfinding signage) vs cabinet/B/1440-initial.png and cabinet/B/source.html#L10 (applies alternating decorative card background tints)
contentToThesis.tradeoff: Mounting holes in Variant A are decorative CSS border-radius circles rather than intrinsic features of the supplied SVG graphics.

suppliedArtifactsShapeComposition.evidence: cabinet/A/1440-compare.png and cabinet/A/source.html#L10 (preserves native vector proportions on balanced neutral stages) vs cabinet/B/source.html#L10 (forces aspect-ratio: 1.48 in grid and aspect-ratio: 1.6 in comparison, causing varied letterbox spacing across different diagram shapes)
suppliedArtifactsShapeComposition.tradeoff: Square panels such as SC-05 show wider letterbox margins inside Variant A's 5:3 container stage.

coherentMediaTypeDirection.evidence: cabinet/A/source.html#L10, cabinet/A/1440-initial.png, and cabinet/A/1440-compare.png (consistent neutral #e4e6db stage background across all views) vs cabinet/B/source.html#L10 and cabinet/B/1440-initial.png (alternating card background tints #e4e5db, #e9e2d4, #e1e5dc that do not reflect metadata)
coherentMediaTypeDirection.tradeoff: Variant A's uniform neutral stage provides less visual contrast between adjacent dark-bordered panels.

honestEvidenceLimits.evidence: cabinet/A/source.html#L34,L58 and cabinet/A/1440-detail.png ('Original illustrative diagrams', 'No claim of historical authenticity or physical condition', 'Recorded dimensions are listed separately') vs cabinet/B/source.html#L31,L75 and cabinet/B/1440-detail.png ('A fictional archive of original illustrative diagrams', 'Illustration is not a scale drawing')
honestEvidenceLimits.tradeoff: Disclaimers in both variants are static strings without deep provenance metadata.

limitations: Static review restricted to provided PNG captures at 1440px and 320px; dynamic animation performance and transitions were not assessed.
No screen reader audio verification was conducted; semantic judgments rely on source inspection and automated check assertions.
Neither variant connects to a remote backend; behavior reflects client-side fixture demonstration rules only.
